overview.en: A short teahouse trek through Gurung and Magar villages and rhododendron forest to the Poon Hill viewpoint, famous for sunrise over Dhaulagiri and the Annapurnas. Good for first-time trekkers and families.
overview.ne: गुरुङ र मगर गाउँ तथा लालीगुराँसको वन हुँदै पुन हिल दृश्यस्थलसम्म जाने छोटो पदयात्रा, जहाँबाट धौलागिरि र अन्नपूर्णमा सूर्योदय देखिन्छ। पहिलोपटक पदयात्रा गर्नेहरू र परिवारका लागि उपयुक्त।

stages.notes: Gentle walk up the Modi and Bhurungdi valleys via Birethanti (ACAP check post).
Long stone staircase to Ulleri, then forest to Ghorepani.
Sunrise at Poon Hill, then along the ridge over Deurali to Tadapani.
Downhill through forest to Ghandruk; jeep back to Pokhara.

overview.en: A classic trek up the Modi Khola gorge into the Annapurna Sanctuary, a natural amphitheatre of peaks above 6,000 m, with Annapurna I and Machhapuchhre close at hand.
overview.ne: मोदी खोलाको गल्छी हुँदै अन्नपूर्ण अभयारण्यसम्म पुग्ने प्रसिद्ध पदयात्रा, जहाँ ६,००० मिटरभन्दा अग्ला हिमालहरूले घेरेको दृश्य देखिन्छ।

stages.notes: Via Birethanti and Kimche, or by jeep most of the way.
Over Komrong Danda and down to the Kimrong Khola, then up to Chhomrong.
Down the Chhomrong stairs, across the river and through Sinuwa.
Through Dovan and Himalaya; watch for avalanche warnings in spring.
Via Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700 m) into the Sanctuary.
Sunrise at base camp, then a long descent.
Back over Chhomrong to the hot springs at Jhinu.
Walk out to Siwai or Nayapul and drive to Pokhara.

overview.en: Fly to Lukla and walk through Sherpa villages and monasteries to the foot of the world's highest mountain, with two acclimatisation days and a sunrise climb of Kala Patthar.
overview.ne: लुक्लासम्म उडेर शेर्पा गाउँ र गुम्बाहरू हुँदै विश्वको सर्वोच्च शिखरको फेदसम्म पुग्ने पदयात्रा, जसमा दुई दिन उचाइ अनुकूलनका लागि आराम गरिन्छ।

stages.notes: Mostly downhill along the Dudh Koshi after the flight from Kathmandu.
Enter Sagarmatha National Park at Monjo; steep climb after the Hillary Bridge.
Acclimatisation day: hike to the Everest View Hotel and sleep in Namche again.
Balcony trail to Phunki Tenga, then a steep climb to the monastery.
Through Pangboche into the Imja valley.
Acclimatisation day: climb Nangkartshang Peak and sleep in Dingboche.
Past Thukla and the climbers' memorials.
To Gorak Shep, then a return walk to Everest Base Camp.
Sunrise on Kala Patthar, then descend to Pheriche.
Long descent via Pangboche and Tengboche.
Back down the Dudh Koshi to Lukla for the flight out.

overview.en: The closest major trek to Kathmandu, following the Langtang Khola through forest to Tamang villages and yak pastures under Langtang Lirung.
overview.ne: काठमाडौँबाट सबैभन्दा नजिकको ठूलो पदयात्रा, लाङटाङ खोलाको किनारै किनार वन हुँदै लाङटाङ लिरुङ हिमालमुनिका तामाङ गाउँसम्म।

stages.notes: Through Bamboo along the Langtang Khola.
Out of the forest at Ghodatabela into the open valley.
Short day past mani walls and prayer wheels.
Acclimatisation hike to Kyanjin Ri, back to Kyanjin Gompa.
Long descent back down the valley.
Back to the road head; bus or jeep to Kathmandu next day.

overview.en: A quieter ridge trek near Pokhara that climbs through rhododendron forest to open grassy ridges right under Machhapuchhre and Mardi Himal.
overview.ne: पोखरा नजिकको शान्त पदयात्रा, लालीगुराँसको वन हुँदै माछापुच्छ्रे र मर्दी हिमालको फेदसम्मको खुला डाँडामा पुगिन्छ।

stages.notes: Via Australian Camp, Pothana and Deurali.
Short forest climb; first close view of Machhapuchhre.
Above the tree line via Badal Danda.
Early climb to the upper viewpoint, then back down to Low Camp.
Steep descent to Siding; jeep to Pokhara.

overview.en: A journey from green Marsyangdi valleys to the dry Tibetan-style villages of Manang and Mustang, crossing the 5,416 m Thorong La. This version starts at Dharapani, where the jeep road from Besisahar ends.
overview.ne: हरियो मर्स्याङ्दी उपत्यकादेखि मनाङ र मुस्ताङका सुख्खा गाउँसम्म, ५,४१६ मिटर अग्लो थोराङ ला पार गर्ने पदयात्रा।

stages.notes: Through Danaque and Timang with views of Manaslu.
Past the curved Paungda Danda rock face.
Upper route via Ghyaru and Ngawal for big Annapurna views.
Acclimatisation day: hike towards Ice Lake (or Gangapurna Lake) and sleep in Manang.
Gradual climb through Gunsang.
Short day via Ledar; rest for the pass.
Start before dawn; cross Thorong La and descend 1,600 m to Muktinath.
Down the Kali Gandaki via Kagbeni; fly or drive to Pokhara.

overview.en: A short but steep trek from Dhunche to the sacred Gosaikunda lakes, with views of Langtang, Ganesh Himal and Manaslu from the Laurebina ridge.
overview.ne: धुन्चेबाट पवित्र गोसाइँकुण्ड तालसम्मको छोटो तर ठाडो पदयात्रा, लौरीबिना डाँडाबाट लाङटाङ, गणेश हिमाल र मनास्लु देखिन्छन्।

stages.notes: Steady climb through forest via Deurali.
Up the ridge; short day to help acclimatise.
Past Saraswati and Bhairav Kunda to the main lake.
Back down the ridge.
Descend to Dhunche; bus to Kathmandu.

overview.en: A remote restricted-area trek around the world's eighth-highest mountain, up the Budhi Gandaki gorge and over the Larkya La into the Annapurna region. A licensed guide and agency permit are required.
overview.ne: विश्वको आठौँ अग्लो हिमाल मनास्लु वरिपरि घुम्ने दुर्गम पदयात्रा, बुढीगण्डकीको गल्छी हुँदै लार्के ला पार गरेर अन्नपूर्ण क्षेत्रमा झरिन्छ। लाइसेन्स भएका गाइड र एजेन्सीमार्फत अनुमति आवश्यक छ।

stages.notes: Along the Budhi Gandaki past the Tatopani hot spring.
Through Philim and the Nupri gorge.
Into Tibetan Buddhist villages with mani walls.
Via Lho with views of Manaslu.
Acclimatisation hike to Pungyen Gompa or Birendra Lake; sleep in Samagaun.
Short climb up the valley.
Rest early for the pass.
Cross the Larkya La and descend to Bimthang.
Down through forest to the Dudh Khola.
Join the Annapurna Circuit; jeep to Besisahar.
